_comment: The 'What's possible' section's catalog, and the renderer's input (scripts/render-lucy.mjs). `prompt` is sent to lucy-2.5 verbatim with Decart's prompt rewriter OFF, so the text the site types out is exactly what the model received. Change a prompt → re-render that clip.

capabilities.label: Character swap
capabilities.blurb: Recast the streamer as someone, or something, else.
capabilities.prompt: Replace the person with a medieval knight in polished silver plate armor and a red cloak, helmet visor up, same pose and movements, sitting at the same desk in front of the microphone

capabilities.label: Add an object
capabilities.blurb: Drop something into the shot that tracks with the scene.
capabilities.prompt: Add a bright green parrot perched on the person's right shoulder, turning its head and ruffling its feathers, everything else in the scene unchanged

capabilities.label: Background edit
capabilities.blurb: Move the whole stream somewhere else. The streamer stays put.
capabilities.prompt: Replace the room behind the person with a tropical beach at sunset, palm trees and golden light on the ocean, the person, desk and microphone unchanged
reactions: wait where did the room go

capabilities.label: Style change
capabilities.blurb: Redraw the stream in a different medium, frame by frame.
capabilities.prompt: Redraw the entire scene as a 1980s cel-shaded anime with bold black ink outlines, flat colors, soft film grain and a neon pink and teal sunset palette

capabilities.label: VFX
capabilities.blurb: Weather, fire, magic: effects that light the room.
capabilities.prompt: The room is flooded with molten lava, glowing orange cracks across the floor and walls, embers floating in the air, intense volcanic lighting on the person's face

capabilities.label: Remove an object
capabilities.blurb: Erase something from the shot and fill in what was behind it.
capabilities.prompt: Remove the headphones from the person's head so their hair and ears are visible, everything else in the scene unchanged

capabilities.label: Change an attribute
capabilities.blurb: Tweak one detail: hair, clothes, colour, age.
capabilities.prompt: Change the person's hair to bright electric blue, same hairstyle and lighting, everything else in the scene unchanged
